hook: THE PART THEY SAID TO FIX|CHANGED THE WORLD

voices.name: l00
voices.text: People told her <#0.2#> to be more outgoing.
voices.caption: People told her to be more outgoing.

voices.name: l01
voices.text: Susan Cain played the extrovert <#0.2#> as a lawyer for seven years.
voices.caption: Susan Cain played the extrovert as a lawyer for seven years.

voices.name: l02
voices.text: Then she explored the quiet she'd tried to fix, <#0.2#> and wrote a book.
voices.caption: Then she explored the quiet she'd tried to fix, and wrote a book.

voices.name: l03
voices.text: Temple Grandin is autistic, <#0.2#> and she thinks in pictures.
voices.caption: Temple Grandin is autistic, and she thinks in pictures.

voices.name: l04
voices.text: With that difference, <#0.2#> she changed how countless farms work.
voices.caption: With that difference, she changed how countless farms work.

voices.name: l05
voices.text: What made them different <#0.3#> was their power.
voices.caption: What made them different was their power.
